description: Look up DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS) for any hostname, resolved live from our server.

faqs.a: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and NS — pick the type from the dropdown before looking up.
You will see a clear 'no records found' message for that type. The domain may simply have no records of that type.
faqs.q: What if a domain has no records of that type?

faqs.a: The query goes to the site's /api/dns endpoint, which resolves the records server-side and returns them as JSON.

howto: Type a hostname such as example.com.
Read the records in the results table.
title: DNS Lookup
